**AV3-007** (Aeris V3, CHC): 68 minutes of unplanned downtime over 76 operating hours ≈ 89 min per 100 hours — the highest rate among sub-500-hour devices (next closest were ~60–70 min/100h). Its vendor risk score is 57, well below the highest-risk Aeris V3, AV3-024 at 85 — so the worst actual downtime performer was not flagged as the riskiest.

FINAL: AV3-007 vs AV3-024
